reason: Putting the washed greens in the flight meal box seems the natural way to take the garden along; it is also the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect the greens to be packed for the flight, completing the goal.

effect: The greens are packed as expected and the chapter is complete; the image places the garden beside the discovery for the journey.
reaction: The quiet contrast between the leaves and the ice is satisfying, though the action itself was automatic.

mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the meal box beside the ice makes the garden feel like a personal part of the return, alongside the scientific discovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The packing action offered no decision or challenge; it was the only combination and its result was predictable.

surprise.text: Nothing in the action surprised me; I expected the greens to be packed.

arbitrary.text: No; putting washed greens into a meal box clearly serves the stated goal.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what happens when the discovery reaches Earth, but this single automatic action alone did not make me eager for more combination gameplay.
